Small Community Hospital Pilot: hospitals in counties with no town over 15,000 people or in the Delta can add services or one new facility within five miles without a certificate of need; up to eight dialysis facilities statewide; geriatric psychiatric unit licenses; Humphreys and Issaquena counties exempt entirely; losing appellants pay fees; apply by June 30, 2027. Mandatory minimum sentences for sexual battery (5 to 30 years first offense, 10 to 40 second) and a new crime of capital sexual battery with the death penalty available when a child 12 or younger is abused and suffers organ damage. Effective July 1, 2026.
Mississippi Keeping Kids Safe Online Act: social media safety curriculum from the Department of Education, limits on features interactive computer services offer minors. Effective July 1, 2026.

Requires state and local agencies and public colleges to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement and honor ICE detainers; bans sanctuary policies; the attorney general can sue to force compliance. Crypto kiosk rules: operators need a Money Transmission Modernization Act license, cannot call kiosks ATMs, must post fraud warnings. Effective July 1, 2026.
Adds firearm safes to the Second Amendment sales tax holiday. Effective July 1, 2026.
State general obligation bonds for the Mississippi Outdoor Stewardship Trust Fund. Confirm it became law.

Passed in 2024 and effective July 1, 2026: first-time driver's license applicants must complete a certified driver's education course; high schools must offer one; road test required.
$2,000 pay raise for university professors (SB 3063 covers community college faculty). Check both numbers.
Judicial pay raise of $10,000 to $13,000 for Supreme Court, Court of Appeals, circuit and chancery judges; find the bill number (2026 session).

Winter Storm Fern relief: zero-interest loans to cities and counties until FEMA reimburses, then 3%; the first version was vetoed. Find the bill number (2026 session).
The $7.36 billion state budget for fiscal 2027 and the $1.17 billion Medicaid appropriation; explain how the budget works and where the money goes. Find the general appropriations bill numbers.
